messages:
sylvie: quick heads-up  customer integration broke after the invokeEnvelope rollout; parser crashed on a stringified arguments field.
jamie: can you paste the minimal payload?
sylvie: from the support ticket:
```json
{"invokeEnvelope": {"tool": "search","arguments": "{\"q\":\"pricing api\"}"}}
```
marco: classic double-encoded arguments. Plan: add a short H3 'Compatibility adapters' to /docs/guides/structured-output.md with tiny defensive snippets for py/ts and a one-line Go sketch.
tasha: editorial: pick consistent term (recommend "invokeEnvelope") and include an anchor so partners can link directly. Also remind to run link-checker.
jamie: python snippet I'll add:
```py
import json
def safe_args(env):
    a = env.get('arguments')
    if isinstance(a, str):
        try: return json.loads(a)
        except json.JSONDecodeError: return {}
    return a or {}
```
marco: TS version I'll add, plus a one-line unit test showing normalized output. I'll open a draft PR and tag eng-ml.
eng-ml: ack — recommend we advise strict schema validation first, then a tiny tolerant adapter (no regex hacks).
tasha: checklist for PR: 1) snippets in py/ts/go, 2) anchor present and link-check green, 3) consistent terminology, 4) eng-ml ack. I'll do final editorial pass.
marco: opened draft PR 5110 with patches to structured-output.md (status: draft) and pushed snippets.
sylvie: will reply to the support ticket with the workaround and link when merged. Closing when PR merged. :white_check_mark:
